name: miblox
description: MiBlox — a cross-platform blocky sandbox game engine with Luau scripting

scripts.build: npm run build -w @miblox/wasm && npm run build -w @miblox/core && npm run build -w @miblox/luau && npm run build -w @miblox/server && npm run build -w @miblox/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @miblox/core && npm run test -w @miblox/luau && npm run test -w @miblox/server
